name: City University of Seattle
tagline: Agentic enrollment, advising, and student-success workflows for a career-focused, multi-modality university.
overview: CityU of Seattle is a private nonprofit university offering 60+ certificate-to-doctorate programs online, on campus, and hybrid for working adults, transfers, military, and international students. Agentic AI can compress advisor response time, transfer-credit evaluation, financial-aid navigation, and at-risk student outreach while keeping admissions and academic decisions under human control.
painPoints: Prospects bounce between program fit, tuition/aid, and modality questions before reaching an enrollment advisor
Transfer credit evaluation and transcript intake still create days of lag before a clear path to graduation
Student success depends on coordinating enrollment, academic advising, financial aid, and career support across siloed systems
strategicImpact: Improved persistence via earlier, personalized outreach for at-risk students

singleAgents.name: Program Fit Concierge
singleAgents.role: Matches prospects to CityU programs by goals, modality, and degree level
singleAgents.trigger: Website chat, Request Info form, or advisor handoff
singleAgents.output: Shortlist of programs with start dates, modality notes, and advisor CTA
singleAgents.roi: Faster first-response; higher quality advisor appointments

singleAgents.name: Transfer Credit Estimator
singleAgents.role: Drafts preliminary transfer credit maps from unofficial transcripts
singleAgents.trigger: Transfer student uploads transcript or asks about credit acceptance
toolStack: Registrar rules (AA up to 65 / BA up to 135)
singleAgents.output: Unofficial credit estimate + missing-official-transcript checklist (not a final evaluation)
singleAgents.roi: Days cut from 'what will transfer?' uncertainty; fewer repeat advisor calls

singleAgents.name: Aid & Affordability Navigator
singleAgents.role: Explains tuition, scholarships, aid, partnerships, and military benefits paths
singleAgents.trigger: Prospect asks about cost, reimbursement, or funding options
singleAgents.output: Personalized funding checklist + next steps (FAFSA, partnership verification, advisor meeting)
singleAgents.roi: Lower cost-related melt; clearer packaging before enrollment

singleAgents.name: Student Success Pulse Agent
singleAgents.role: Flags at-risk enrolled students and drafts advisor outreach
singleAgents.trigger: LMS inactivity, missed registration for next 10-week quarter, or early alert
singleAgents.output: Risk tier + suggested outreach script + recommended support resource
singleAgents.roi: Earlier interventions; improved continuation across quarterly starts

multiAgent.name: Enrollment Journey Pod
multiAgent.description: A supervisor-led multi-agent team that moves an adult learner from inquiry to a clear enrollment plan across program fit, admissions, transfer, and funding — with humans owning admits and official evaluations.

supervisor.name: Enrollment Journey Supervisor
supervisor.responsibilities: Owns prospect outcome through apply/enroll, prevents contradictory advice across modalities and student types, and escalates policy exceptions to human Enrollment Advisors.
supervisor.routingLogic: Goals/program questions → Program Fit; transcripts/transfer → Transfer Agent; cost/aid/military → Affordability Agent; international/visa → International Compliance Agent; ready to apply → Application Coach.

subAgents.name: Program Fit Agent
responsibilities: Map goals to Business, Technology, Education, or Health programs
Call out modality limits (e.g., programs not 100% online)
subAgents.contextHandoff: Recommended program path + constraints to Supervisor

subAgents.name: Transfer Pathway Agent
subAgents.contextHandoff: Unofficial pathway estimate for advisor review

subAgents.name: Affordability Agent
responsibilities: Route military benefit questions to correct playbook

subAgents.name: International Compliance Agent
subAgents.contextHandoff: Compliant pathway recommendation for human international advisors

multiAgent.conflictResolution: Official transfer evaluations and admission decisions are always human/registrar-owned. Agents never promise aid awards or visa outcomes. When modality rules conflict with student preference, policy wins and the supervisor offers alternate programs. FERPA-sensitive records stay in approved systems with least-privilege tool access.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Ingest inquiry (chat/form/advisor), student type (first-time, transfer, military, international, graduate), goals, and any uploaded transcripts.

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Enrollment Journey Supervisor builds a plan covering program fit, start term, credit strategy, and funding path.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Specialist agents query catalog/SIS/CRM knowledge, draft estimates and checklists, and schedule advisor follow-ups.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Enrollment/Academic Advisors confirm recommendations; Registrar finalizes official transfer credit; Financial Aid packages awards.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Student receives a clear next-step plan, free application path, and booked advisor support through registration.

apis: Document intake for official transcripts (e.g., to registrar@cityu.edu workflows)
vectorDbs: Financial aid, scholarship, and partnership playbooks
Advisor macros and alumni outcomes talking points
security: No automated official credit or aid decisions
PII minimization in prompts and chat logs
Role-based access for advisors vs. prospects
Audit trails for recommendations and human overrides
